title: Open candidate alpha PNG in installed Kinovea

input.provenance: Byte-identical copy of the tracked deterministic candidate alpha PNG; candidate baseline is not approved.

preconditions: Use the verified existing win64 Wine prefix and matching Kinovea executable.
No Kinovea window may already be open.
The logged-in KWin/Xwayland session and required automation tools must be available.

actions.description: Capture Kinovea at startup before opening media.
Open the fixture through the shortcut route.
Capture the main window after the open action returned.
Verify that the player header identifies this image and its dimensions.
Capture the first stable view of the opened still image.
Request one frame step forward using the default keyboard action.
Capture the visible result of frame stepping.
Capture the visible result after stepping back.
Request player close with Ctrl+F4 and record the visible result.
Capture the application after closing the player.
Check whether the player header remains after Ctrl+F4.

cleanup: Harness sends Alt+F4 only to the Kinovea window launched by this run; never calls wineserver -k.
evidenceConfidence: OCR checks only visible player header metadata; a human reviews presentation and controls.
limitations: OCR can produce false negatives and is not a pixel or numerical equivalence test.
Frame-step screenshots do not establish exact timestamps.
Screenshots do not establish alpha values or premultiplication.

expectedOutcomes.observation: The image opens in a player showing its filename, dimensions and 25.00 fps header.
expectedOutcomes.verification: OCR assertion plus window screenshot review.

expectedOutcomes.observation: The player canvas shows the image; toolbar and timeline are present.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Manual visual review; raster details for tiny fixtures are not established.
NOT_ESTABLISHED; the scenario records whether the header remains after the request.
